hypothesis: S5.2 The Concern Conversion Rate (docs/12:310) — the share of expressed-concern statements followed by the same member sponsoring an on-topic bill within 180 days. Headline: 'X% of congressional concern is never followed by a bill.'
source: Registration frozen and committed BEFORE any measurement run (docs/23 §4 + §7.2 item 5; the p-hacking hole docs/12:457 names). Concern statements from the congress-press corpus (Lane-1); sponsorship from govinfo BILLSTATUS bulkdata 113-119, local at X:/onscript-data/bills/raw (keyless, sha256-manifested). Companions confirmed with Michael 2026-07-20: floor 300/cell + comparative gate (his §4 confirm), on-topic primary = >=2 tokens (his 2026-07-20 confirm). No post-hoc edits.
rationale: Floors are numerals fixed before touching confirmatory data (docs/12 L4). The three companion registrations that were the real p-hacking surface — the concern-detector lexicon, the 180-day window, and the on-topic match rule — are frozen here as a committed artifact; the measurement script reads them and adds no knob.
concern_lexicon_note: Party-blind, anchored on the pipeline's existing build._CONCERN set and expanded to the DIRECTED forms only (concern + preposition/complementizer), because a directed concern names a TOPIC the sponsorship can be matched against; a bare 'concerned' often has no extractable object. Matched case-insensitively anywhere in a Lane-1 release. A concern STATEMENT = a solo (non-joint), non-syndicated Lane-1 press release by a D or R member (bioguide present) containing >=1 lexicon phrase.

parameters.window_note: Kept from the hypothesis. Conversion requires introducedDate in (concern_date, concern_date + 180 days]. Same-day and prior sponsorships do NOT count (the concern must PRECEDE the bill).
parameters.topic_of_concern: The content-token SET of every sentence in the statement that contains a concern-lexicon phrase (pipeline boilerplate.sentences() tokenizer; union across a statement's concern sentences). Using the concern sentence(s) — not the whole release — keeps the topic to what the member is concerned ABOUT and avoids coincidental whole-release matches. A CONTENT token = a token that survives boilerplate.STOPWORDS AND is not one of the concern-lexicon tokens AND is not in generic_stoplist below.
parameters.bill_topic: The content-token SET of (official short title + CRS policyArea name + all legislativeSubjects names) of a sponsored bill, same tokenizer + same content filter. Titles are year-stripped like the nomenclature index. CRS policyArea/legislativeSubjects are authoritative party-blind topic tags assigned by the Congressional Research Service.
parameters.on_topic_primary: >=2 distinct content tokens shared between topic_of_concern and bill_topic
parameters.on_topic_note: Primary threshold K=2 confirmed with Michael 2026-07-20. K=1 (loose, upper-bound conversion) and K=3 (strict, lower-bound conversion) are reported alongside every cell as disclosed bounds; the VERDICT uses K=2. A stricter CRS-tags-only variant (share must be a policyArea/subject token, excluding title tokens) is also reported as a robustness column.
parameters.conversion: A concern statement CONVERTS iff its member (same bioguide) sponsors >=1 bill that is on-topic for the statement (>=2 shared tokens with topic_of_concern) with introducedDate in the 180-day window. Conversion rate (per cell) = converted / eligible concern statements. Headline non-conversion rate = 1 - conversion rate.
parameters.generic_stoplist_note: Frozen a priori. Excluded from BOTH sides of the on-topic match (beyond STOPWORDS) because these tokens are common to concern language AND bill titles/subjects and would manufacture coincidental topical links, inflating the conversion rate. Declared here so the choice is auditable, not silent.
parameters.right_censoring_guard: A concern statement is ELIGIBLE only if concern_date + 180 days <= the latest introducedDate present in the local BILLSTATUS corpus. Statements whose window extends past available sponsorship data are EXCLUDED (not counted as non-conversions), because their conversion is unobservable. The excluded count is reported.
parameters.sponsorship_source: govinfo BILLSTATUS 113-119, all 8 bill types (hr, s, hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres). Fields used per bill: sponsors/item/bioguideId, introducedDate, title, policyArea/name, subjects/.../legislativeSubjects/item/name. Cosponsorship is NOT counted — the hypothesis is about the member SPONSORING (authoring) a follow-up, the strongest form of legislative follow-through.

floor_and_cells.floor_note: Michael-confirmed (docs/23 §4). Minimum 300 eligible concern statements per reported cell. Power: the headline is a binomial proportion; at p=0.5, n=300 gives a 95% CI half-width of +-5.7pp. Cells below 300 are pooled or reported 'insufficient', never a headline.
floor_and_cells.comparative_gate: A party-difference claim requires BOTH party cells >=300 AND the D-R gap to exceed the summed 95% CI half-widths (~8pp at p=0.5). Otherwise only the pooled rate publishes.
floor_and_cells.era_half_note: Era-halves are the docs/17 provenance-lane halves, applied to the concern statement's congress. Sponsorship matching is lane-agnostic (a bill has no press-provenance lane) — the era-half only buckets the concern statements. The 300 floor was verified clearable in every cell before this freeze (lower-bound counts from the existing text_features concern field: pooled D=22,000 / R=12,721; smallest era-half cell 689).

verdict_criteria: This is a rate-report, not a binary CONFIRM/REFUTE hypothesis — the number IS the finding (docs/12: 'CONFIRM: the rate itself is the headline'). A card ships iff the pooled cell clears 300 (it does) and the rate is stark/publishable per docs/20; a party-difference sub-claim ships only through the comparative gate. Reported honestly whatever it is.
amend_policy: This registration is FROZEN. No post-hoc edits to concern_lexicon or parameters (docs/23 §7.2 item 5). A genuine design change is a NEW registration with a new date, never an edit to this one. The measurement script scripts/search/s5_2_concern_conversion.py must implement exactly these rules and is auditable against this file.

amendments.reason: Initial freeze. Companions (lexicon, 180-day window, on-topic rule) frozen and committed BEFORE any measurement run, per docs/23 §7.2 item 5. Floor 300 + comparative gate are Michael's §4 confirm; on-topic primary K=2 is Michael's 2026-07-20 confirm. Substrate verified present (BILLSTATUS 113-119 local with sponsor/date/policyArea/subjects; concern-statement denominators clear 300 in every cell). Measurement follows in the same session but as a SEPARATE later commit, so the freeze precedes the result in git history.
